title: Notion AI Playbook: How I automate system with Notion AI
caption:
How I automate system with Notion AI

Here's the exact playbook:
1️⃣ One home for SOPs — Refund policy, client notes, content ideas — if it isn't in Notion, AI can't answer from it.
2️⃣ Query your own docs — 'What's our refund policy?' — answered from your pages, not the open web's guesses.
3️⃣ Template the structure — Database templates give every new lead the same fields. No rogue rows, no missing context.
4️⃣ Summarize every meeting — Action items extracted automatically — nobody re-reads a transcript to remember what was due.
